headline.title: Musk v. Altman week 2: OpenAI fires back, and Shivon Zilis reveals that Musk tried to poach Sam Altman
headline.summary: In the ongoing trial between Elon Musk and OpenAI, Musk accused CEO Sam Altman and president Greg Brockman of misleading him regarding his $38 million donation to the organization. Additionally, Shivon Zilis disclosed that Musk attempted to recruit Altman away from OpenAI.

articles.title: Laid-off Oracle workers tried to negotiate better severance. Oracle said no.
articles.summary: Laid-off Oracle employees attempted to negotiate improved severance packages after discovering they did not qualify for WARN Act protections, which typically require two months' notice. Oracle attributed this classification to their status as remote workers, leading to dissatisfaction among the affected individuals.

articles.title: ZAYA1-8B Technical Report
articles.summary: The ZAYA1-8B model, developed by Zyphra, is a reasoning-focused mixture-of-experts model featuring 700 million active parameters and a total of 8 billion parameters, built on the MoE++ architecture. It demonstrates competitive performance against the DeepSeek-R1-0528 model on various mathematics and coding benchmarks while utilizing a full-stack AMD compute platform for its training processes.

articles.title: FinRAG-12B: A Production-Validated Recipe for Grounded Question Answering in Banking
articles.summary: The article introduces FinRAG-12B, a framework designed for training domain-specific large language models (LLMs) in the banking sector, addressing challenges such as accuracy, regulatory compliance, and the need for verifiable responses. This production-validated approach aims to enhance answer quality and citation grounding while ensuring compliance with real-world deployment constraints.

articles.title: Skill1: Unified Evolution of Skill-Augmented Agents via Reinforcement Learning
articles.summary: The article introduces Skill1, a framework designed for the unified evolution of skill-augmented agents through reinforcement learning. It emphasizes the importance of a persistent skill library that enables agents to select, execute, and distill skills effectively, addressing the limitations of existing methods that optimize these capabilities in isolation.

articles.title: ViTok-v2: Scaling Native Resolution Auto-Encoders to 5 Billion Parameters
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced ViTok-v2, a Vision Transformer auto-encoder model that scales to 5 billion parameters, enhancing image tokenization and reconstruction capabilities. The study addresses limitations of existing ViT tokenizers, particularly in maintaining performance outside training resolutions and improving stability during scaling.

articles.title: Tamaththul3D: High-Fidelity 3D Saudi Sign Language Avatars from Monocular Video
articles.summary: Researchers have developed Tamaththul3D, a system that generates high-fidelity 3D avatars for Saudi Sign Language using monocular video, addressing the lack of quality 3D annotations in Arabic Sign Language. The project includes the first high-quality 3D parametric annotations for the Ishara-500 dataset, enhancing avatar generation for the approximately 400 million Arabic speakers.

articles.title: Two Steps Are All You Need: Efficient 3D Point Cloud Anomaly Detection with Consistency Models
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced a novel approach to 3D point cloud anomaly detection using diffusion models, which enhances reliability and efficiency in manufacturing quality assurance. This method addresses the challenges of existing techniques that are often computationally intensive or ineffective in complex environments, making it suitable for resource-constrained and latency-sensitive applications.

articles.title: X-Voice: Enabling Everyone to Speak 30 Languages via Zero-Shot Cross-Lingual Voice Cloning
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced X-Voice, a multilingual zero-shot voice cloning model capable of replicating voices in 30 languages without the need for prompt text or complex preprocessing. The model, trained on a 420K-hour multilingual corpus using the International Phonetic Alphabet, utilizes a two-stage training paradigm to achieve its capabilities.

articles.title: When2Speak: A Dataset for Temporal Participation and Turn-Taking in Multi-Party Conversations for Large Language Models
articles.summary: The article introduces When2Speak, a synthetic dataset designed to improve large language models' performance in multi-party conversations by focusing on the timing of interventions. The dataset aims to enhance conversational coherence by addressing the challenges of turn-taking and participation in dialogue.

articles.title: Leveraging Image Generators to Address Training Data Scarcity: The Gen4Regen Dataset for Forest Regeneration Mapping
articles.summary: The paper presents the Gen4Regen dataset, designed to enhance forest regeneration mapping by utilizing image generators to mitigate the shortage of expert-annotated imagery. It highlights the potential of Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) for scalable data collection while addressing challenges in deep learning interpretation due to limited training data.

articles.title: The Missing Evaluation Axis: What 10,000 Student Submissions Reveal About AI Tutor Effectiveness
articles.summary: A recent study highlights the need for a behavioral evaluation axis in assessing AI tutoring systems, based on an analysis of 10,000 student submissions. The authors argue that while pedagogical quality is important, understanding how students utilize feedback is crucial for a comprehensive evaluation of AI tutor effectiveness.
